# User Guide

## Getting Started

1. Start the FastAPI QA backend.
2. Start the Vite frontend.
3. Open the dashboard in the browser.
4. Configure a Project and Environment before creating testing records.

## Recommended Operational Sequence

```text
Project
→ Environment
→ Test Asset
→ Test Plan
→ Test Cycle
→ Execution
→ Results and Artifacts
→ Report
→ Delivery
```

## Version Traceability

- Editing a Test Asset creates a new immutable version.
- Saving a Test Plan captures the selected asset versions.
- Creating a Test Cycle preserves the definitions used by that cycle.
- Historical snapshots remain available even when the live asset changes.

## Data Safety

- Do not clear browser localStorage unless records have been backed up.
- Never commit `.env`, tokens, credentials, or target-system passwords.
- Review store migration results whenever a persisted schema version changes.
